slides.title: Prices still rise too fast
text: Price rises over 12 months to September (PCE).
Higher rates are the Fed's tool to [slow them down].
slides.source: Fed minutes Oct 27-28, staff estimates for September

slides.title: Decision day: Dec 9
text: Most bet on 0.25 point. Waller wants 0.5.
Higher rates make cash pay more and {pull money from risky bets} like crypto.
slides.source: CME FedWatch via Decrypt, Cointelegraph; Fed calendar

sources: Federal Reserve, minutes of the FOMC meeting Oct 27-28, 2026 (released Nov 18): rate held at 3.75-4% by 10-2 vote (Cook, Hammack wanted +0.25); almost all participants judged further rate increases likely appropriate; a couple said more than 25 bp could warrant consideration next meeting; staff: PCE inflation 3.6%, core 3.1% in September; Kevin Warsh chairman
Decrypt (Nov 18): Waller on CNBC, 'You might need to, like, shock people', 'go 50 in December'; Dec 8-9 meeting; futures ~95% for 25 bp, ~5% for 50 bp
Cointelegraph (Nov 18): Waller 'shock' 50-point hike; FedWatch odds of 25 bp hike above 95%; BTC below $63,000, down ~3%
